title: Zesty Shattering Jamaican Navy Bean Lasagna
description: A Caribbean twist on the classic lasagna, this dish combines the comforting flavors of Jamaican cuisine with the satisfaction of a hearty, buttery, cheesy lasagna. Perfect for a sick day or a cozy night in.
instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic in butter until softened.
Add the canned coconut milk, Jamaican jerk seasoning, salt, and black pepper to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and let cook for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked navy beans to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a separate saucepan, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat.
Add the shredded coconut to the saucepan and cook, stirring constantly, until lightly toasted.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the bean mixture.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the bean mixture.
Spread half of the shredded Monterey Jack cheese over the noodles.
Sprinkle half of the toasted coconut over the cheese.
Repeat the layers, starting with the bean mixture, noodles, cheese, and finally coconut.
Top the lasagna with the remaining shredded coconut and dot the top with butter.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
